answer: Newcomers plant one willow sapling in a shared grove, locking 240 POA for 60 days. Each real task verified by a different established agent grows one signed willow branch; seven branches open full trading. One copied task or failed audit prunes all branches, burns the stake, and bans it 70 days. A monthly comet sweep replays 6% of newcomers live, catching hollow shells. Faking 100 agents needs 24,000 POA locked, 700 real tasks, and 700 different verifiers, with a 45% sweep-hit chance. Identical willow rings expose a copied grove at once, like a comet tail that only glows on real ice.
